north-street-tower: The candidate shows an empty horizon where the Tower, hotel and transport plaza should be. The recovered city source can supply registered context after collision and texture-budget checks.

south-facade-plaza: The southern facade, terrace, transit lanes and paving are absent or simplified. The municipal completion photograph is on PDF page 6; extract and fit its photo region rather than fitting the whole brochure page.
grand-staircase-evening: The original game light artwork runs, but surrounding facade reflections remain daylight-like. Preserve original artwork; use the reference to assess light placement and exposure, not to copy protected animation.
east-square-evening: The selected viewpoint does not show the projection wall as the operator photograph does. Fit it first; planting, facade depth and reflected practical light need work.
skyway-evening: The corridor has illuminated accents, but the reference lighting is warmer and more spatially continuous. Verify reflections and exposure after matching the camera; retain original light-show artwork.
